components.name: Badge
components.summary: A small label that states a status or category.

components.name: Callout
components.summary: A block-level message that explains what happened and what to do next.

components.name: Card
components.summary: A grouped block of related content on surface-100.

components.name: Checkbox
components.summary: A box for choosing any number of independent options, or for agreeing to one statement.

components.name: CodeBlock
components.summary: Shows code as a block with a file bar, or inline inside a sentence.

components.name: Conversation
components.summary: The signature pattern: a quiet reading column with a soft composer, where the reader's words sit in a bubble and the reply sits directly on the page.

components.name: Menu
components.summary: A floating list of actions opened from a button.

components.name: Modal
components.summary: A dialog that interrupts the page for a decision that must be made now.

components.name: Select
components.summary: A dropdown for picking one option from a list of five or more.

components.name: Sidebar
components.summary: The persistent left navigation of an app.

components.name: Tabs
components.summary: Switches between views of the same subject without leaving the page.

components.name: TextField
components.summary: A labeled single-line input with optional helper or error text.

components.name: Toggle
components.summary: A switch for a setting that takes effect immediately.

components.name: Tooltip
components.summary: A short label that names an icon-only control on hover and keyboard focus.
